name: SL Basics BB Block SPF 50g | Tinted Sunscreen with Vitamin E, Lotus & Niacinamide
description:
SL Basics BB Block is a revolutionary tinted sunscreen that combines SPF 50+ broad-spectrum protection with skin hydration and flawless coverage. Enriched with Vitamin E, Lotus Flower Extract, and Niacinamide, this lightweight formula nourishes skin while shielding against UVA/UVB rays. Available in three undertones (Oak, Mahogany, Birch), it suits all skin types and ensures a radiant, natural-looking finish every day.

Key Features
SPF 50+ broad-spectrum UVA/UVB protection
Lightweight tinted formula with flawless coverage
Enriched with Vitamin E & Lotus Extract for hydration
Niacinamide helps brighten and even skin tone
Available in warm, cool & neutral undertones
Non-comedogenic, suitable for all skin types

Ingredients / Materials
Vitamin E, Lotus Flower Extract, Niacinamide, Titanium Dioxide, Glyceum, Hydrating Base Formula

How to Use
Apply evenly to clean, moisturized skin before sun exposure
Reapply every 2–3 hours for continued protection
Suitable as a daily tinted sunscreen or makeup base

Package Includes
1 × SL Basics BB Block SPF 50g (Tinted Sunscreen)
